ton_host_disjoint.outcome: feasible: every class keeps training support on every seed

ciciomt2024_provider_split.established: The dataset authors split at the level of pcap files: 80% of the pcap files form 'train' and 20% form 'test' (Dadkhah et al., CICIoMT2024, Internet of Things 2024; the sentence was obtained through search results for the paper, which is paywalled and could not be opened here). Test flows therefore come from pcap files never used in training.
ciciomt2024_provider_split.not_established: Whether the pcap files are separate recording sessions or chunks of one recording per attack. Several attacks have many numbered train files and two numbered test files (for example TCP_IP-DDoS-ICMP 1-8 train, 1-2 test), consistent with either reading. The CSVs carry no timestamps.
ciciomt2024_provider_split.duplicate_rate: see results/journal_partB/B5 (exact feature-vector duplicates between the provider partitions)
